**Major update: Switches from DOM scraping to direct REST API calls using browser-captured tokens for Microsoft Teams data access.**

- Now reads Teams chats, channels, messages (including unread states), inline images, and Activity feed via the private chat-service REST API, not browser DOM scraping.
- Adds shell helpers for bearer token capture from a Teams browser tab; all data calls run server-side with curl, not through a browser extension.
- Recipes and usage now reference REST endpoints and include paging, unread message, and image retrieval logic; Activity feed is accessible as a conversation.
- Removes previous DOM selector setup and file (references/dom-list-recipes.md); adds REST API recipes (references/chatsvc-recipes.md) and token management shell script.
- No longer limited to the chat currently open in the browser — any chat/channel can be read by id.
- Stronger privacy and safety guidance for reads and writes, emphasizing token care and explicit approval before posting messages by script.

Initial release: Read Microsoft Teams data from an open browser tab using the fpx CLI, without needing the MCP server.

- Enables read-only access to chats, teams, channels, and messages via DOM extraction from a signed-in Teams Web tab.
- No login or token required; relies on the Transporter browser extension and fpx's dom-list capability.
- Requires manual navigation in Teams: only reads whichever chat or channel is currently open.
- Includes setup instructions for fpx profile and dom-list selectors.
- Provides usage examples and exit codes for troubleshooting.
